summary: Verified preview URL is fully reachable and renders correctly. HTTP 200 on both `/` and `/api/`. Desktop viewport (1280x900) renders the app inside the phone-shaped device mockup (dark bezel with notch, box-shadow), mobile viewport (390x844) renders edge-to-edge without a frame — exactly as intended. All target strings visible on both viewports (`Total portfolio`, `Aarav`, `novelty`). Bottom-tab navigation (Home ↔ NovaAI) and the Aarav↔Meera user switcher both work. Backend `/api/nova/chat` accepts requests and validates payloads (422 on missing `message`); the LLM path currently returns 502 with 'Budget has been exceeded! Max budget: 0.0' from litellm — this is a WARNING (LLM key needs top-up), not a blocker for prototype access. Backend pytest suite: 3/3 pass. User's 'unable to open the link' report is not reproducible from this environment — the link opens and renders on both viewports.

minor.issue: LLM call returns 502 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0, Max budget: 0.0'. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY has no budget. Prototype UI still loads — NovaAI chat is the only affected feature. Top up the key to enable live chat.

issues: Cosmetic: the notch is drawn INSIDE the padded frame (padding:10) so it sits ~16px below the top edge of the bezel, giving a small gap between the top of the device and the notch. On a real iPhone the notch is flush with the top. Consider `top: 0` and moving the notch outside the inner padded screen, or wrapping the screen in an inner View so the notch overlays the bezel edge. Purely visual — does not affect functionality.

Cosmetic: Bottom safe-area padding (paddingBottom: Math.max(insets.bottom - 8, 8)) uses insets that are 0 in the desktop web frame, so the tab bar sits tight against the rounded bottom of the phone — acceptable but slightly cramped.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web console warning: 'Invalid DOM property `transform-origin`. Did you mean `transformOrigin`?' fired twice on load. Not from this repo's source directly — comes from a dependency's inline style. Non-blocking but noisy in console. Reference: browser console at page load.

action_items: Optional: top up EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget so NovaAI chat returns 200 instead of 502.
Optional cosmetic: nudge the notch to the true top edge of the frame (currently top:16 inside a 10px-padded container leaves a visible gap above the notch on desktop).

Reply to user: the link is live and opens on both desktop and mobile — ask them what browser / network they used, or share a screenshot of the failure. Most likely their previous session cached an older build or a corporate proxy blocked *.preview.emergentagent.com.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 154: `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` is defined AFTER it is referenced inside nova_chat's except block (line 134). If the except path is hit before module fully initialises this would NameError — in practice logger is defined at import time so it works, but declare it near the top for clarity.
server.py: `datetime.utcnow` is deprecated in Py 3.12+; use `datetime.now(datetime.UTC)`. Non-blocking here (Py 3.11).
server.py nova_chat: replays only user turns from history (comment acknowledges assistant turns are dropped) — for a demo this is fine, but multi-turn coherence will degrade.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL https://79b87750-db5c-404f-92b3-f0bcc68cab14.preview.emergentagent.com/ loads fine. DeviceShell in /app/frontend/app/_layout.tsx activates at width>520 (Platform.OS==='web'). If retesting, use viewport 1280x900 for desktop mockup and 390x844 for mobile. testIDs: `tab-home`, `tab-nova`, `user-switcher-aarav`, `user-switcher-meera`, `theme-toggle-button`, `pro-modal-backdrop`, `pro-cta-button`. Nova chat returns 502 due to LLM budget=0 — accept 200 or 502 in assertions.
rca_of_issue: User bug 'unable to open the link' is NOT reproducible. Direct curl returns HTTP 200 with valid Expo HTML, Playwright loads and interacts with the app on both desktop (1280x900) and mobile (390x844) viewports. All required content (`Total portfolio`, `Aarav`, `novelty`) is visible. Phone mockup shell renders on desktop, disappears on mobile as designed. Likely user-side causes: (1) stale browser cache from a prior failing build, (2) corporate/school network blocking *.preview.emergentagent.com, (3) they hit an intermittent Metro bundle window right after a redeploy. Mitigation: ask user to hard-refresh, try a different browser/network, and share a screenshot + browser dev-tools network tab if it still fails.
